# Code Anchors: Config Write-Back

- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/delivery_config.py` — the surgical add-only block writer and its config-root discovery, plus the detect and write entry points setup drives.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/test_writeback_integration.py` — the round-trip integration coverage: unrelated sections, comments, and formatting survive the write, and declared keys are never overwritten.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/test_delivery_config.py` — unit coverage for the writer, including gap-fill-only semantics and leaving the current-repo target absent.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-epic/scripts/nxs_gh_create_epic.py` — the unattended producer on the epic path: persists the classification and project it resolved on a first fallback run.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/scripts/create_gh_issues.py` — the same unattended write-back on the story path.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.setup.md` — the attended producer: detects classification, lists candidate projects and asks when several match, falls back to safe values with a recorded reason when the tooling is unreachable, and reports the seeded block for review.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.epic.md` — surfaces the unattended seed in its completion report so the uncommitted config change is reviewed and committed.
